title: Profile pictures
what: The profile picture of every room and person the provider has seen, kept current from the owner's account in the data folder, with the reader's store holding when each was taken.

title: Reader configuration
what: The reader's configuration read from the shared environment: the owner's MTProto application values, the seam token and ports, the data folder, and the bot and owner numbers.

title: History walk
what: The past messages of the rooms the receiver names, walked back on the owner's account and handed over as history, numbered below every live message with progress kept per room.

title: Live reading
what: The live reading on the owner's account: every new message another bot writes in a listened room is turned into a live message and handed to the service on the one shared connection.

title: Reader login
what: The script that signs the owner's account in once, asking for the phone number, the code Telegram sends and the password where one is set, and prints the session for BMO_TG_SESSION.

title: Reader media fetching
what: What the owner's account fetches of a message: a picture or file the Bot API will not hand the bot, found by the message number and its second, and the name a file with none is given.

title: MTProto loading
what: The MTProto library the owner's account is read through, loaded the first time something asks for it so a test that never reads the account does not pay for its schema.

title: Owner account sends
what: What is sent in the owner's own voice through the owner's account: one piece of words or one album of files, each answering an earlier message by the number the account holds it under.

title: Reader process
what: The bun process in reader/: it waits for the service and the session lock, opens the owner's account once and starts the live reading, history walk and picture sweep, with health saying why it stands down.

title: Reader routes
what: The reader's loopback routes the service calls: whether the owner's account is connected, a picture or file fetched through it, and a send in the owner's voice, all under the seam's token.

title: Reader service client
what: The service as the reader reaches it over the seam: a live message or gathered patch handed on, a room's listened state, the rooms to walk, the seen record and word of changed pictures.

title: Session lock
what: The lock file that keeps the owner's session to one process: it names the process that holds it, and a lock whose process is gone is free.

title: Reader store
what: The reader's own SQLite store in the provider's data folder: how far each room's history walk has come and which profile picture is held for each room and person.
